causes.label: Control panel is asleep
remedies: Press POWER, the touch screen or any button to activate the control panel.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 41: "Control panel is asleep"

causes.label: Dryer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure cord is plugged securely into a working outlet.

causes.label: Controls are not set properly
remedies: Make sure the cycle was set correctly, close the lid and press START.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 41: "Controls are not set properly"

causes.label: Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped
remedies: NOTE: Electric dryers use two fuses or breakers.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 41: "Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped"

causes.label: Electronics need to be reset
remedies: Unplug dryer, wait 2 minutes, plug back in and press POWER.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 41: "Electronics need to be reset"

causes.label: START was not pressed after a cycle was set
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 41: "START was not pressed after a cycle was set"

causes.label: Door was opened during the dry cycle
remedies: Close the door and reset cycle, to the beginning if necessary.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 41: "Door was opened during the dry cycle"

causes.label: Dryer is too cold
remedies: If the dryer has been exposed to temperatures below freezing for an extended period of time, allow it to warm up before pressing POWER.
Otherwise, the display will not come on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 41: "Dryer is too cold"
